provenance.construction: Halving of the two-block code [[66,4,10]] (codes/66-4-10.json) along the fixed-point-free ZX-duality that exchanges (1,h) and (2,c-h) (symplectic halving: Lee, Okada, Maskara, Kasai, Zhou, arXiv:2609.30069, Def. 3; Burton, Durso-Sabina, Brown, arXiv:2406.09951); equivalently the mirror code of Khesin and Lu (arXiv:2603.05496) with A = c - F_B, B = F_A. Parent: G = Z/3 x Z/11, element (a,b) with index 11a+b; qubit (1,h) -> index of h, (2,h) -> 33 + index of h; X-check g on (1, g+F_A) and (2, g+F_B), Z-check g on (1, g-F_B) and (2, g-F_A), F_A = {(0,0),(1,7),(2,0)}, F_B = {(0,0),(1,6),(2,7)}; this is codes/66-4-10.json after renumbering G (the board file numbers G by GAP's Elements(SmallGroup(33,1))). Involution: Psi(1,h) = (2, c-h), Psi(2,h) = (1, c-h) with c = (0,0). Fold: fold qubit i is (1,h) with h of index i; the X-check g gives the generator with X on g+F_A and Z on c-g-F_B (Y where they meet), in the order of the X-checks. n = 33, rank 31, k = 2; 25 generators of weight 6, 7 of weight 5 and 1 of weight 4; 9 Y factors in 8 generators; not locally Clifford equivalent to a CSS code.
provenance.notes: Distance 7 is exact: no nontrivial logical of Pauli weight <= 6 by three independent exhaustive computations (tropidist b03ec2d4077f in the board's Pauli encoding, certs/33-2-7.json in the same pull request; a meet-in-the-middle search of ours; Magma V2.30-1 MinimumDistance), and the witness has weight 7. Programs, data and logs: github.com/TimoKellerMath/quantum-error-correction @ 207d1130035a, folded-stabilizer-codes/. Not locally Clifford equivalent to a CSS code: the generator-level parity system for single-qubit Cliffords has no solution (qubit 0 carries X, Y and Z), and every generator is the only nontrivial stabilizer supported in its support, so no single-qubit Clifford makes the group CSS. At board commit 8042f9da no stabilizer entry dominates or equals it; it dominates the stabilizer entries 34-2-7-s (on n). It is a mirror code of Khesin and Lu (arXiv:2603.05496) with G = Z/3 x Z/11, A = {(0,0),(1,4),(2,5)}, B = {(0,0),(1,7),(2,0)}, not in their code table (they describe their search over abelian |A| = |B| = 3 as almost exhaustive up to n = 300); in the sources of our literature check (summarized in the README of folded-stabilizer-codes/) we found no published code with the parameters [[33,2,7]]. The tables of codetables.de list a [[33,2,10]] code, a dense code without weight restriction. No CSS entry dominates or equals it either. Checked, not equivalent to an existing entry.
